name: Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues

criteria.description: Presence of large pleomorphic lymphoid cells with hallmark horseshoe-shaped nuclei
Strong CD30 expression and ALK protein positivity (in ALK-positive subtype)
Detection of ALK gene rearrangement (e.g., t(2;5)(p23;q35)) by FISH or PCR
Lymphadenopathy with or without extranodal involvement

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of hallmark cells with CD30 positivity plus either ALK protein expression or ALK gene rearrangement
diagnosticCriteria.notes: ALK-negative ALCL diagnosis requires exclusion of other CD30+ lymphomas and demonstration of characteristic morphology and immunophenotype.

distinguishingFeatures: Reed-Sternberg cells instead of hallmark cells
CD15 and CD30 positivity but ALK negative

New onset extranodal masses or skin lesions
